Lemma
[Hyperbolic cusp lower barrier] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0078 ↗ lem:chow-iv-schwarz-pick 1. ch28:28.47\group Finite Width

For each $t<0$, the cylindrical conformal factor satisfies \[ \widehat u(s,\theta ,t)\ge c(t)s^{-2},\qquad u(r,\theta ,t)\ge \frac{c(t)}{r^2(\log r)^2} \] near infinity, with $c(t)$ uniformly positive on compact time intervals.
